caption: Each cell is one column and its number is the width in pixels on the 960 px row, where one of the 12 units is 80 px: row A gives three 320 px columns, row B gives 640 px and 320 px. The last row shows three 6-wide columns, whose spans total 18, so the third 480 px column wraps to a new line instead of shrinking.

spec.title: One 960 px row = 12 units of 80 px
spec.aria: Four Bootstrap rows on a 960 px content width, with column widths in pixels: row A has three 4-span columns of 320 px each, row B has an 8-span column of 640 px beside a 4-span column of 320 px, row C is a single 12-span column of 960 px, and a last row of three 6-span columns of 480 px each totals 18 spans so the third column wraps to a new line.
